__comment: Trade Counter — the room-anchor furniture piece that designates a sealed room as a Shop.
This is the first furniture definition in the game. Its schema establishes the pattern
for all future furniture items.
ROOM DESIGNATION:
A sealed room (enclosed walls + one or more doors) containing a Trade Counter
is automatically designated as a 'shop' room. The room type is re-evaluated
whenever any furniture is added to or removed from the room.
Only one Trade Counter per room is valid. A second counter invalidates the room
designation until one is removed.
ROOM VALIDATION:
A shop room may only contain items whose furniture_category is listed in
room_compatible_categories. If any item with a category in
room_invalidating_categories is placed inside the room, the Shop designation
is immediately removed. The room reverts to an undesignated room until the
offending item is removed.
See furniture_category field on each furniture item for its category string.
SELL SIDE (automated):
All items stored in room_compatible storage units inside the shop room are
automatically available for sale when a merchant visits. The merchant checks
each item against their want list and buys matching stock at
base_trade_value ± demand_modifier. The colony receives gold coins equal to
the transaction total. Sold items are removed from shop storage immediately.
BUY ORDERS (player-configured, automated):
The player configures buy orders on the Trade Counter via the UI.
Schema per order: { item_id, max_count, max_price_per_unit }
When a merchant carries an item matching a buy order:
- The colony buys as many units as available up to max_count.
- If gold coin balance is insufficient for the full order, partial fill applies:
buy as many units as coins allow at the stated price.
- Purchased goods are placed in available shop room storage first.
If shop storage is full, goods are dropped on the shop floor.
- Dwarves then haul floor goods to appropriate colony stockpiles.
Buy orders persist indefinitely and re-evaluate on every merchant visit.
Default: empty array (no buy orders). Configured per save, not in this file.
COIN FLOW:
Net coins = coins received from sales − coins spent on buy orders.
If net is positive, gold coins are added to the nearest stockpile_currency stockpile
or dropped at the Trade Counter if none exists.
If net is negative (buy orders exceed sale revenue in a single visit),
the deficit is drawn from the colony's existing coin stockpile.
If the colony cannot cover the deficit, buy orders are partially filled
until coins run out.
MERCHANT VISIT CONDITION:
Merchants will only stop at the colony if a valid shop room exists AND the
shop has at least one item in storage OR at least one active buy order.
A shop room with a Trade Counter but no stock and no buy orders is treated
as inactive — caravans pass by without stopping.
TRADE NOTIFICATION:
On trade completion a summary toast is posted:
'Trade complete — sold X items, bought Y items, net +Z coins.'
Full transaction log is accessible from the Trade Counter inspect panel.
description: A heavy stone slab counter. Marks the room as an active shop and manages all trade with visiting merchants.
__comment_collision: collision_regions defines one or more axis-aligned boxes in furniture-local block coordinates.
Origin (0,0,0) = bottom-front-left corner of the footprint. Y is up. Units are game blocks (0.5 m).
Each region is read by the furniture placement system to create CollisionShape3D nodes at runtime.
Multi-region is used when different parts of the piece have different heights (e.g. beds).
A single region covering the full footprint at the correct visual height is the common case.

buy_orders_schema.__comment: Runtime schema — buy orders are saved per-colony, not defined here.

fields.max_count: Maximum units to buy per merchant visit (integer ≥ 1)
fields.max_price_per_unit: Colony will not pay more than this in gold coins per unit (integer ≥ 1)
